cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. What do you gain if your cousin wins the club election?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And which of your proposals becomes easier to approve?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I know which square of competence we're discussing.
